name: Dynasty Builder
summary:
Open a lacquered box and watch a masterpiece rise out of it in a column of light. Then it breaks apart into dozens of pieces, and it's your turn.

Dynasty Builder is a hands-on VR building game about classical Chinese architecture. Pick up stone platforms, columns, painted beams, interlocking dougong brackets and tiled roofs, and fit them together in the order real carpenters did. Every piece knocks into place.
